comment: The section correctly states that emerging technologies depend on trusted registries, terminology, information models, and interoperability. However, it may imply that countries should delay all AI use until the complete DPI-H foundation is mature.

public.text: The section correctly states that emerging technologies depend on trusted registries, terminology, information models, and interoperability. However, it may imply that countries should delay all AI use until the complete DPI-H foundation is mature.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that bounded AI use cases may proceed with fit-for-purpose local foundations and controls, while national scale and reuse require progressively stronger shared DPI-H capabilities.
